title: Rollback failed coordinator-local completion persistence
summary: Give coordinator-local terminal completion the same job-scoped rollback boundary as remote completion and persist a merged recoverable claim when registry or rerun-row durability fails.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-021. Local mark_done removed the active job and updated counters before its first durable save, but did not capture or restore rollback state when persistence failed, allowing duplicate work or contradictory restart ownership.
affected_areas: Network CSV rerun local completion ordering
completion counters and failure ledger rollback
in-flight registry persistence and restart recovery
behavior_before: CoordinatorQueueMixin.mark_done called registry.complete before persistence. Ordinary save failure propagated with the target removed in memory; local Network rerun mutated its row before attempting the registry save. Neither path restored the target job, counters, statistics, or failure evidence.
behavior_after: Local completion captures a per-job rollback receipt before mutation. Any ordinary save failure restores and persists only that target while preserving concurrent unrelated work. Network rerun completion durably saves the completed registry before row mutation, and either save or row compare-and-set failure restores and persists the claim.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_workflow.py: failed local outcome save failure restores the active job, session_failed counter, and failure ledger in memory and after restart.

tests/python/desktop/test_network_workflow.py: local Network rerun save failure occurs before row mutation, and a row compare-and-set conflict rolls the durably completed registry back to an active restart-recoverable claim.

tests/python/desktop/test_network_workflow.py: ordinary local success save failure restores the target while preserving an interleaved unrelated completion and new claim, then reloads the merged state from disk.
